paite: Babulon luite gei ah, huai ah i tu a, ahi, i kap zel a, Zion i ngaihtuah hi.
heading: Saltanna A Israelte Kahla
english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

paite: Huai a muisumte ah i kaihgingte i khai ua.
english: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.

paite: Zion la khat hon saksak un, chi in sal a hon pite'n la sa ding in ahon sawl ua, hon hih gentheite'n nuamsa ding in leng ahon chi nak uhi.
english: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”

paite: Mi gam peuh ah bangchi in TOUPA la i sa thei dia?
english: How can we sing Yahweh’s song in a foreign land?

paite: Jerusalem aw, ka hon mangngilhleh, ka khut taklam in athilsiam mangngilh hen.
english: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

paite: K'on theihgige keileh, ka dangtawng ah ka lei belh bikbek hen; ka nopsakna pen sang a Jerusalem ka deih zawk keileh.
english: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

paite: TOUPA aw, Jerusalem ni in Edom suante theigige in. Asuangphum nangawn chimsak un, chimsak un, chite.
english: Remember, Yahweh, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”

paite: Babulon tanu aw, hihman a om ding; ka tung ua na hih bang a hon thuk ding pa kipak in a-om ding hi.
english: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.

paite: Na tanu noute hon laksak a, suangpi satna dia zang ding pa kipaktak in a-om ding hi.
english: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
